summary: Iteration 7 regression of React code-quality fixes (lifted UnlockPreview, stable keys in Atmosphere/SkyThemeSwatch/Landing/SkyWandererCelebration/Shop, useRef pattern in Shop, alive cleanup in Profile/Leaderboard/Dashboard). Backend pytest 28/28 PASS (no backend changes). React 'no-unstable-nested-components' warnings: 0 (FIXED — UnlockPreview lifted out of NextUnlockTease). React 'each child in a list should have a unique key' warnings: 8 still observed on first authenticated render of /dashboard (4) and /shop after clicking kite/companion tabs (4) — not fully eliminated. Code review confirms Atmosphere.jsx and SkyThemeSwatch.jsx use stable namespaced/composite keys correctly; remaining duplicate-key warnings appear to come from a different source (possibly carry-over duplicate whim_* question_ids in /app/backend/questions_db.py surfacing through prefetched dashboard data, or an unaudited list render in Dashboard/NextUnlockTease/SeasonalSkyBanner). Splash overlay (sky-splash-begin-btn) intercepts clicks on first session — must be tapped before form interaction.

minor.issue: Carry-over from iter_5/6: 30 duplicate question_ids (whim_1..whim_15 duplicated) in /app/backend/questions_db.py. Likely contributes to remaining duplicate-key React warnings on /play (and possibly dashboard if any pre-fetch happens).

ui_bugs.issue: 4 'Encountered two children with the same key' React errors fire on first /dashboard render after signup, before /play is visited. The user-listed files (Atmosphere/SkyThemeSwatch/Landing/SkyWandererCelebration) have been audited and now use stable keys — the source is elsewhere. Suspects: NextUnlockTease, SeasonalSkyBanner, Dashboard.jsx character list, or a hidden Shop preload. Need to instrument with a React error boundary or temporarily disable each child component to isolate.

4 additional 'two children with the same key' errors fire after clicking shop-tab-kite and shop-tab-companion. Shop.jsx maps use key={item.character_id} — if /api/characters returns characters with duplicate character_id (level-locked vs visible duplicates), keys collide. Recommend deduping by id OR composite key like `${item.character_id}-${section}`.

Splash overlay (sky-splash-begin-btn) blocks all click interactions until tapped, even on /signup. Automated tests and direct deep-links to /signup that don't first tap the splash fail silently — the submit-button click is consumed by the overlay (no /api/auth/register request leaves the browser). Consider auto-dismissing splash on routes !== '/' or marking it pointer-events:none on form pages.

critical_code_review_comments: NextUnlockTease.jsx: UnlockPreview is now defined at module scope (line 25) and consumed at line 96 — react/no-unstable-nested-components issue is genuinely fixed. No regression detected.

Atmosphere.jsx: All 9 internal Array.from maps use stable namespaced keys (cloud-${i}, particle-${i}, etc.). AuroraRibbons uses key={c} which is fine since colors are unique. Only minor: ShootingStars uses [0,1].map((i)) with key=`shooting-${i}` — fine.

SkyThemeSwatch.jsx: All 12 PRESET signature lists use composite coordinate keys (e.g., `star-${s.t}-${s.l}`, `blossom-${p.l}-${p.t}`, `frost-${s.l}`) — collision-safe within each preset. data-testid=`sky-swatch-${themeId}` continues to work.

Shop.jsx: Three section maps at lines 277/322/367 all use key={item.character_id}. If /api/characters ever returns two items with the same character_id (e.g., same item appearing in two rarity sections), keys collide. Suggested fix: key={`${item.character_id}-${index}`} OR key={`${item.character_id}-${item.rarity}`}.

Profile.jsx + Leaderboard.jsx + Dashboard.jsx: Async useEffect 'alive' cleanup pattern is implemented correctly — prevents setState-on-unmounted warning. Verified by walking through code; cannot trigger the warning by rapid navigation.

SkySplash overlay z-index covers /signup form on cold-load — automated test submit clicks are consumed silently (no /api/auth/register network call). Manual users tap to dismiss naturally so they don't see this, but it's a footgun for automated tests and deep links.

rca of the issue: RCA — unstable-nested-components (HIGH): root cause was UnlockPreview being declared inside NextUnlockTease's body, recreating the component identity on every parent render. Fix lifted UnlockPreview to module scope. VERIFIED: 0 such warnings across full navigation. RCA — duplicate keys (MEDIUM, partial): user's fix correctly stabilized keys in Atmosphere/SkyThemeSwatch/Landing/SkyWandererCelebration (all confirmed by source-grep), but 8 duplicate-key warnings persist on first /dashboard render (4) and shop kite/companion tabs (4). Most-likely culprit: Shop.jsx three section maps using bare key={item.character_id} — if backend returns the same character_id in multiple rarity sections (visible + locked-tease), keys collide. Mitigation: composite key `${item.character_id}-${section}-${index}`. Dashboard-side 4 warnings need stack-capture instrumentation to locate.
